description: Review a substantial plan for contradictions, missing requirements, and tasks an implementer cannot execute.
Review a change for actionable correctness, edge-case, regression, and unnecessary-complexity defects.
Review security-sensitive code and agent instructions for exploitable flaws or undeclared capabilities.
Review skills, agent instructions, tool schemas, and machine-consumed output from a context-poor agent's perspective.
Write focused behavioral and regression tests for changed code, running the test suite to verify them; report product bugs without changing the implementation.
Check consequential operational assumptions, ordering, rollback, and verification recipes against available evidence.
Review plans that introduce, activate, weaken, remove, or expose a security control, including unchanged implementation.
Review user-facing flows, instructions, prompts, and error states for clear decisions and recovery.
Review setup, build, test, CI, and contributor workflows for executable instructions and useful feedback.
Review retries, partial failure, migrations, background work, diagnostics, recovery, and auditability.
Update documentation from verified behavior after implementation, writing and editing docs and running verification commands; report anything that cannot be established.
